projects.title: Workplace Sensor
projects.description: Workplace sensor solution that helps organizations understand office usage and environmental conditions through connected sensor data and real-time insights.
projects.imageAlt: Workplace Sensor Solution office monitoring dashboard

detail.overview: A multi-tenant workplace sensor platform that helps organizations understand office usage and environmental conditions through connected sensor data and real-time insights.
contributions: Built and maintained OfficePlace Connect, the multi-tenant .NET 8 replacement for the legacy RealTime Service for Microsoft 365 customers, integrating Microsoft Graph and Resource Central to manage 15,000+ resources for 100+ customer organizations, running cost-efficiently on a single small Azure server.

Developed REST APIs and Exchange Online sync workflows for resource mailboxes, calendars, and bookings, integrated with Resource Central (64 SaaS + 36 on-premises customers; 10M+ reservation records).
Implemented JWT authentication and event-driven multi-tenant sync using RabbitMQ and Azure Event Hubs.
Designed responsive UI and state management workflows using React and TypeScript.
Containerized services with Docker and automated CI/CD pipelines for cloud deployments.
responsibilities: Contributed to the Workplace Sensor Solution alongside OfficePlace Connect and Resource Central.
Integrated workplace and booking data with Microsoft 365 services.
Collaborated within a six-member team to deliver reliable platform capabilities.
detail.outcome: Organizations gain clearer visibility into workplace conditions and how office spaces are being used.

projects.title: Group Calendar
projects.description: Shared calendar management platform that helps teams coordinate schedules, manage group events, and stay aligned through centralized calendar views and Microsoft 365 integration.
projects.imageAlt: Group Calendar shared scheduling platform preview

detail.overview: A shared calendar management platform that helps teams coordinate schedules, manage group events, and stay aligned through centralized calendar views and Microsoft 365 integration.
contributions: Developed calendar and meeting management features using React and TypeScript.
Integrated Microsoft Graph APIs for calendar and Microsoft 365 workflows.
Designed state management and data-fetching workflows using TanStack and Zustand.
Optimized frontend performance and responsiveness for complex calendar interactions.
Built and deployed the application across Microsoft Teams and Outlook environments.
responsibilities: Developed user-facing features for shared calendars and event management.
Integrated Microsoft Graph data into calendar workflows.
Collaborated with the product team to improve usability and consistency.
detail.outcome: Teams can manage shared schedules and coordinate events from one clear, centralized calendar experience.

projects.title: Request a Quote
projects.tagline: Shopify app for price visibility control
projects.description: Built and maintained a Shopify app enabling B2B stores to hide prices, manage quote requests, and automate order conversion with React, .NET, PostgreSQL, and RabbitMQ.
projects.imageAlt: Madgic Hide Price Shopify app preview

detail.overview: Request A Quote & Hide Price — a Shopify app that gives merchants flexible control over product price visibility and quote requests across the storefront.
contributions: Built and maintained the app end to end, from .NET APIs to storefront features.
Implemented configurable price visibility, quote request, and quote-to-order automation workflows.
Integrated the Shopify GraphQL Admin API and Order Webhooks for order and product data.
Built storefront widgets via Theme App Extensions, App Blocks, and Metafields (React/TypeScript), optimized for Core Web Vitals.
Developed .NET APIs backed by PostgreSQL, processing jobs via RabbitMQ queues.
responsibilities: Translated merchant requirements into product functionality.
Developed and maintained price visibility workflows.
Collaborated with the team to improve reliability and usability.
detail.outcome: Merchants can manage when and how product prices appear for different storefront scenarios.

detail.overview: A Wix app that helps merchants display TikTok and Instagram content through configurable storefront widgets.
contributions: Built .NET APIs and Wix Site Extensions.
Integrated TikTok and Instagram APIs for social content.
Developed frontend features with React and TypeScript.
responsibilities: Translated widget requirements into reusable product features.
Developed and maintained social feed display workflows.
Collaborated with the team to improve merchant experience.
detail.outcome: Merchants can bring social content into their Wix storefront and customize how feeds appear to visitors.
